title: .dnser.yaml project manifest
description: Per-project overrides read live by the dnser daemon. YAML subset; see docs/projects.md.

command.description: Primary dev-server command. Placeholders: {port} = primary port, {port:<service>} = named service port.

services.description: Named services. Either a mapping keyed by name or a list with explicit name fields.

type.description: Free-form label: redis, postgres, smtp, memcached, http, ...

command.description: Supervised process; mutually exclusive with host.

host.description: External endpoint host (IP or hostname); requires port.

dns.description: Publish <name>.<domain> in DNS. Defaults to true when omitted.

host.description: @ = zone apex, * = wildcard, relative label (api → api.<domain>), or absolute host under the TLD.

backends.description: host:port entries; any host, any port. Port may be {port} / {port:<service>}.

listen.description: Required for tcp/udp routes: local frontend port.
